method: Exact-hash CPU-only continuation with bounded synthetic Windows structures, DLL section data, image mapping, process/handle returns and remote-memory results. No native sample execution, host child, host DLL loading, actual remote-process write, or endpoint contact.

resolved_export.name: BaseThreadInitThunk
resolved_export.verification: The sample hash routine at stage+0x1d9bf returns this value when executed on the candidate name.

data_scanner.address_field: IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER.VirtualAddress (+0xc), added to the DLL base
data_scanner.scan: Unaligned DWORD reads walk backward from VirtualSize-1 through zero. The last read can cover three bytes beyond the nominal section extent.
data_scanner.comparison: The loaded DWORD equals the resolved BaseThreadInitThunk pointer saved at EBP+0x134.

zero_data.conclusion: No matching pointer leads through file/section cleanup to termination of the second synthetic child.

matching_pointer.conclusion: The explicitly seeded matching-pointer branch reaches remote executable allocation, region-copy and thread-resume requests, then a read and overwrite request for the matching slot in the second child.

region_copy.assumption: remote write succeeds symbolically; source bytes are streamed for hashing only, with no host or remote-process write
region_copy.size_limit: 64 MiB equals the synthetic parent mapping extent; this is not a recovered payload size.

thread_resume.assumption: NtResumeThread succeeds for the second synthetic child thread; no child instructions execute

child_global_read.assumption: second synthetic child .data global is initialized to the same synthetic BaseThreadInitThunk pointer; no child instructions or actual remote read execute

target_analysis.conclusion: The requested four-byte child-global overwrite replaces the thread-initialization thunk pointer with an address in the relocated loader, at stage offset 0xaf. This historical stop is continued in nsis-child-checks.json, where the write is modeled only in separate child memory and the copied entry executes in a CPU-only child model.

dll_inputs.architecture: x86 / PE32 / machine 0x14c; use SysWOW64 variants on a 64-bit Windows installation.
dll_inputs.consistency: Files from one Windows installation/build; retain SHA256, PE timestamp, preferred image base and version/build context.

files.name: ntdll.dll
files.needed: PE header/section alignment and export-directory RVA; ordered section table; .data VirtualAddress, VirtualSize and bytes including following padding.
files.runtime_limit: The specific slot is located by its initialized BaseThreadInitThunk pointer. On-disk .data may not contain that runtime value. A relocated/initialized .data view or its slot RVA plus loaded module bases would validate the real branch.

files.name: kernel32.dll
files.needed: BaseThreadInitThunk export RVA and any forwarder, plus its code prefix for future trampoline checks. CreateProcessInternalW export/forwarder metadata is also useful for the earlier adapter.

files.name: mshtml.dll
files.needed: Preferred base, SizeOfImage and section layout/bytes to replace the symbolic remote SEC_IMAGE base and extent.

dll_inputs.helper_command: python inspect_windows_dll_metadata.py ntdll.dll kernel32.dll mshtml.dll --include-data --output dll-metadata.json
dll_inputs.helper_limit: Static parsing only. It does not capture relocated/runtime-initialized globals or load DLLs.

model_correction: The baseline NtAllocateVirtualMemory adapter now stops on non-current-process handles. The optional second-child allocation remains symbolic and cannot silently map child memory into the parent emulator.

limits: The .data descriptor, pointer slot, export address, both child identities and initial child-global contents are synthetic. They demonstrate two branches of the original instructions; they do not establish the exact live Windows slot or timing.

The symbolic image mapping supplies no real mshtml.dll bytes. This report's no-child-execution boundary is superseded by nsis-child-checks.json; final malware-family/payload recovery remains unresolved.

The 64 MiB transfer equals the parent model region extent; only 70 source pages contain nonzero bytes in this run. Its length is not a recovered payload size. Source hashing streams 64 KiB chunks and does not allocate or write a real remote process.
The post-mapping driver permits two million further x86 instructions, bounded API continuations and existing 120-second outer/20-second Unicorn slice and 20,000-exception limits.
Sparse-companion relationships and the production NSIS instruction-stream extraction gap remain unresolved.
